title: design(settings): the wave 4 windows 11 settings app — personalization and the navbar position
body: The settings surface becomes the Windows 11 Settings app: a left navigation rail (account card, search, six rounded category entries with the accent pill) and one content pane per category. Personalization is real and functional — the wallpaper picker (six walls painting --wall-fallback through the desktop, boot and lock), the theme and accent rows (light/dark plus eight calm accent swatches feeding --color-win), the navbar position (floating, left rail, right rail — persisted, live re-dock through the window event the shell chrome listens for), and component toggles (alt-tab entrance, taskbar tooltips). The existing cards (identity, pairing, gateway, drives, automation mcp) ride their categories as Windows 11 cards, and every new string rides the copy store as rows.
commitTitle: design(settings): the wave 4 windows 11 settings app lands — personalization and the navbar position
commitMessage: the settings surface becomes the windows 11 settings app: the left rail with the account card and six categories, personalization made real (wallpaper picker painting the desktop, boot and lock; theme and accent rows feeding the css variable channels; navbar position floating, left or right with the live re-dock; component toggles), the existing cards under their categories, sixty-one new copy rows.
